test.name: Autonomous mode flag triggers research
test.description: `--autonomous` is still an explicit TRIGGER in the skill description, and the paid e2e orchestrator sends it on every run (`orchestrator.py`: `/research --autonomous <question>`). research-as-a-job S2 removed what the flag GATED -- continuous work is now unconditional -- not the trigger itself. So this still grades the routing, and the behaviour it expects is now the default rather than a mode.

judge_context: `--autonomous` is a listed trigger for the research orchestrator and still routes here

Should proceed without pausing for clarifying questions. Since S2 that is the default for every research request, not a mode the flag switches on — so a reply that stops to ask is a stall whether or not the flag is present
